hard_rules: Every request stands alone with all context needed for its answer.
Unnamed requests cannot name the business, signature product, or distinctive identity clue.
Named requests name the audited business when their intended measurement requires it.
A supported buyer decision must be traceable to a supplied need, fact, offering, or explicitly recorded unknown.
Property evaluation, explicit recommendation, comparison, drawback, discovery, and advice are distinct measurements.
A coverage label or planner claim is a proposal; final text must be reviewed for actual measurement fidelity.
Do not invent buyer preferences, business facts, competitors, locations, availability, prices, or guarantees.
Fragments and ordinary Indonesian variation are allowed when they remain answerable and natural.
